description: Derived coordinate values from the actual current implementation, generated by calling geometry/constants.py directly against the default JewelryDefinition during Sprint 5.

prongAngularOrigin.description: prong_0 sits at angle 0 (positive local X axis, local y=0); subsequent prongs increase angle via 2*pi*i/count using math.cos/math.sin, the standard mathematical counterclockwise direction when the local X/Y plane is viewed from +Z looking toward the origin.

worldOrigin: Center of the ring = center of the finger hole = center of the band's revolution.
bandPlane: X/Z plane (band lies in this plane when viewed down Y).
assemblyAnchorAxis: The line x=0, y=0, parallel to global Z, starting at z=band_top_z.
positiveZDirection: Away from the band, toward the stone — 'up' in the ring's own frame.
